name: Ledgerwise Jobs
description: A bright, large-board jobs search: a slim hero, an “assess your fit” band, then one ruled table of roles — team, location and type as columns — with search, a filter bar and pages of twenty.
features: Board preset: table — one ruled table, a column each for team, location and type
Role layout: split — the role beside a column with its facts, Apply and share
A published pay band and a pay-transparency note on every role; one role in two cities
Search box and a filter bar (team, location, type, where the work happens) as dropdowns, 20 roles a page
Composed front page: slim gradient hero, an “assess your fit” band, the board, an equal-opportunity line
Equal-opportunity statement and accommodations contact under every role (front-door words, written once)
Apply form with the voluntary self-identification section and a consent line with a one-year retention window
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting
Type: Inter (served from our own font store)
Office map: the seven offices the roles name, each on a street map

Before you apply, it helps to know how we work. Read these and ask yourself honestly whether they describe a place you would do your best work.
We value
Rigour — we would rather be right than fast, and we try to be both.
Writing — decisions are made in documents, not meetings.
Ownership — you will be trusted with real responsibility from your first month.
Users first — every team can name the customer their work serves.
It may not suit you if
You prefer a fixed scope that rarely changes.
You would rather not write long-form.
Internships and new-graduate roles run every year across engineering, design and finance. Applications open in September for the following summer.
What to expect
A real project that ships to production.
A dedicated mentor and a cohort of peers.
Competitive pay, housing support and travel.
